subject: Ramify cost savings scenarios & decision checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@ramify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ramify discovery — cost levers recap & immediate asks

Alex — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side with the cost/TCO levers we discussed and the concrete asks to prep a scoped pilot. TL;DR: with batching + prefix/KV caching + quantization + routing to cheaper variants we expect to be able to demonstrate 30–50% unit-cost improvement on your most frequent low-latency inference paths within a controlled pilot (numbers below).

What we heard (pain points)
- P1: Token cost is the primary gating factor for expanding chat features — monthly spend is a blocker for wider rollout.
- P2: 95th pct latency spikes during merchant peak windows (~10–20% traffic) causing timeouts in UI flows.
- P3: Ops constraints — limited ability to run complex rollout/unsafe experiments in prod today.

Goals you confirmed
- Reduce per-op incremental cost by ~30% without increasing tail latency beyond current observed levels.
- Maintain p95 < 200ms for the main checkout flow.
- Pilot must fit inside a $25k monthly cap for the first month, and be instrumented for prefix-level QA.

Cost levers (expected single-step ranges; will compound non-linearly)
- Continuous batching (dynamic micro-batching tuned to inter-arrival): 15–35% savings depending on traffic burstiness.
- Prefix/KV caching for repeat prompts: 10–25% savings on eligible paths.
- 4-bit/8-bit quantization on model weights: 10–20% savings with a modest quality delta on long-form contexts.
- Smart routing to cheaper-but-compatible model variants for non-critical routes: 5–15% additional savings.
- Operational levers (cold-start tuning, token trimming at prompt construction): incremental 5–10%.

Pilot-level estimate (rough): combining batching + caching + quantization + routing we expect a 30–50% reduction in token/unit cost for your targeted flows; we'll produce a short ROI table once we receive sample traces.

Immediate asks (what we need from Ramify to scope the pilot)
1) 7-day sample trace (anonymized) with traffic distribution by route + p95/p99 latency broken down by time-of-day. Prefer JSON export or a short CSV.
2) Confirm pilot budget cap (you mentioned $25k/month — please confirm total budget commitment and whether Redwood can run overage alerts).
3) Security contact for paperwork (NDA + if needed SOC 2 scoping).
4) Identify a small list (3) of high-value routes we should prioritize (checkout chat, merchant verification, support quick-responses).

Proposed pilot timeline (high level)
- Week 0: NDA + sample data handoff + pilot config approval
- Week 1: Baseline measurement in existing stack (no changes) + initial modeling of batching/caching expected savings
- Week 2–4: Iterative tuning (safe canary routing, cache pins, batching windows)
- Week 5: Readout with ROI table and recommendation (go/no-go on scale)

Attachments: ramify-pilot-scope-v1.pdf (pilot scoping doc, 3 pages) attached.

Next steps: Alex — can you send the sample trace by end of day Friday? Ben/Karthik — I'll need a 30-min internal sync tomorrow to propose the pilot config (instance sizes, batching thresholds, SLA targets).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Irene.Choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ramify discovery — cost levers recap & immediate asks

Nice summary — agree with the lever breakdown. Quick internal notes:
- I'll draft a simple ROI table based on the 7-day trace once we have it; rough calc will show sensitivity to batching window and cache hit rate.
- For the pilot config I'll plan two tracks: Hosted (fastest path) vs Dedicated (predictable latency at scale). Recommend we propose both and let Ramify pick given their ops comfort.
- Can we include a small spreadsheet with breakpoints (cache hit % -> net savings) so their product team can play with scenarios? I'll attach the starter CSV.

Attachment: roi-table.csv (starter sensitivity table)

Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Eng 
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Morgan <alex@ramify.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: techlead@ramify.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ramify discovery — cost levers recap & immediate asks

Irene — this is great, thanks. Confirming:
- We'll export an anonymized 7-day trace (JSON) and drop it into the Drive link you provided by Friday EOD. Our infra lead (cc'd) will also add notes about current runtime configs.
- $25k/month cap is acceptable for month 1; happy to add usage alerts (we prefer hard alerts + email notification to product owners).
- For security, please send over the mutual NDA and we'll assign our security contact.

On canary rollouts: yes we'd like to see a staged canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%) for any routing/quantization changes. How do you typically handle rollback?

Forwarding their earlier note: "On Tue, Jul 20, 2027 at 13:40 Alex Morgan <alex@ramify.ai> wrote: Let’s also get a perf baseline before changes — we need hard numbers to measure regressions."

Appreciate the clear asks — we'll aim to meet them.

— Alex

Head of Product, Ramify
alex@ramify.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Ramify pilot — owners & immediate actions

Internal follow-up (owners):
- Ben: Own sensitivity ROI table and produce two scenario sheets (hosted vs dedicated) by Thu EOD. Use current rois assumptions: batching 20% baseline, cache hit 12% baseline, quantization 12% baseline.
- Karthik: Draft pilot infra config with canary rollout recipe (5/20/100) and automated rollback conditions (p95 increase > 15% or error rate spike > 2%). Also include monitoring hooks for token accounting.
- Irene: Send NDA draft + ramify-pilot-scope-v1.pdf to Alex; set up 30-min sync with product tomorrow 10:00 PT.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with the timeline and link the Drive folder. Keeping the ask tight — sample trace + budget confirmation are the gating items.

Thanks — will post updates to the thread as they arrive.
Irene
